maya: Quick question — customer (AcmeRetail) asking to run thalia-22b for multi-turn summarization in Dedicated. Before we escalate, can ML do a short candidacy pass? Need quality delta vs our baseline, quantization viability, and a rough perf/cost estimate. Link to model repo: https://git.internal/redwood/models/thalia-22b
samir: Quick clarifying q's — target QoE metric(s)? typical prompt+response lengths? throughput/CONC targets? any extra compliance constraints?
maya: They want 2–3 turn summaries of long transcripts (~2k tokens), responses ~150–300 tokens. Target ~200 concurrent sessions peak per tenant. Must be HIPAA-compliant (so private deployment + KMS). Latency goal p95 < 1.2s for response if possible.
elaine: Proposed minimal vetting (short checklist):
- Eval: run 250-example summarization set (customer + internal) — compute ROUGE-1/2/L and selectivity/regression vs baseline model.
- Perf smoke: p50/p95 at seqlen 256 and 2048, batch sizes 1/4/8 to estimate cost curves.
- Quant probes: nf4 and int8 quick runs to measure generation fidelity and perf delta.
- Safety/regression: run our safety eval harness and existing regression tests.
- Ops: rough dedicated slot sizing and monthly token cost estimate.
If someone can spin the model I'll run the eval harness.
samir: Quick perf snippets I use:
```
# perf probe
python perf_probe.py --model thalia-22b --batch 8 --seq 2048 --ngpus 1 --tokens 300
# quant probe
python quant_probe.py --model thalia-22b --schemes nf4 int8
```
maya: Uploaded customer sample prompts to /mnt/secure/acme_thalia_samples.csv (encrypted). They prefer nf4 if quality holds.
quant-bot: Automated quant probe finished for thalia-22b: nf4 delta BLEU -0.9, int8 delta BLEU -6.4. nf4 latency overhead negligible. Results: s3://redwood/quant/thalia-2461802345/
ops-bot: Heads up — free dedicated slot window tomorrow 06:00–12:00 PST on pool "dedi-x-large" if you want to run smoke jobs.
samir: I'll pick this up tomorrow AM: will run eval + nf4 checks. @elaine can you run the safety suite post-eval? If metrics look OK I propose a 'pilot promotion' path: 2-week pilot, canary at 10% then 50% with auto-fallback to baseline.
maya: Sounds good — tagging @julie-prod for rollout constraints :thumbsup:
julie-prod: Noted — we need SLA table, fallback/rollback policy, and confirmation of KMS key ownership. Also check whether the customer needs audit logs retained longer than default.
